name: clean-end-of-session
description: Winds agents down cleanly as the session's credit runs out and has the orchestrator write a resume memo.

showSettings.title: clean-end-of-session
showSettings.description: Shows or hides the clean-end-of-session settings below.

sessionThreshold.title: clean-end-of-session · Session trigger threshold (%)
sessionThreshold.description: Share of the 5-hour session window used that starts the clean stop.

weeklyThreshold.title: clean-end-of-session · Weekly trigger threshold (%)
weeklyThreshold.description: Share of the 7-day window used that starts the clean stop; its last few percent are about one whole session.

overageBudgetUsd.title: clean-end-of-session · Overage budget ($)
overageBudgetUsd.description: Estimated spend allowed past 100 % to finish the clean stop; once spent, no request leaves anymore.

graceToolCalls.title: clean-end-of-session · Grace tool calls
graceToolCalls.description: Tool calls each subagent keeps after its warning, before its tools are cut off.
